Subject Anti-Air Raid Research Society (防空研究會) and
Shanghai Municipality Air Defence Society (上海市防空學會).
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]
The Anti-Air Raid Research Society is sponsored
by the Aviation Commission at Nanchang and came into
existence in November, 1934, with General Chiang Kai-shek
as Chairman. A branch office was subsequently established
in Shanghai and is at present located at No.225, Rue Chapsal
(Vide Intelligence Report 18/12/34 - extract attached).
The person in charge of this branch office is one named
Soo Kung-vong (蘇公望), a member of the Aviation Commission.
Under the auspices of this branch office, lectures
bearing on air defence were delivered between 4.30 p.m. and
5 p.m. on the Tuesdays of four consecutive weeks, beginning
December 18, 1934, over the radio station of the Great China
Dispensary, Foochow Road. Efforts have been made to secure
the drafts of these lectures but without success. Apart
from this propaganda, the Shanghai Branch Office has so far
conducted no activities nor published any pamphlets.
The Shanghai Municipality Air Defence Society,
formerly known as the Shanghai Municipality Air Defence
Research Society, is an organization formed under the
direction of the Shanghai City Government, its office being
located at 175 Avenue Dubail. This Society is the publisher
of the Shanghai Air Defence, a monthly magazine.
Up to the present, five issues of this periodical
have been published, the 4th and 5th issue, bound in one
volume, making its appearance on August 15, 1935. The
contents of these magazine deal principally with aviation
and air defence with reproduction of photographs bearing
on these subjects, but comments on current political events
are also included.

报告
档案号：警务处登记处 D 6671
日期：1935年9月5日。
主题：防空研究会及上海市防空学会。
撰写人：督察 Sih Tse-liang 转呈人：[签名]

防空研究会由南昌航空委员会发起，于1934年11月成立，蒋介石将军任会长。随后在上海设立分会，目前地址位于霞飞路225号（参见1934年12月18日情报报告——附摘录）。该分会负责人名为苏公望（Soo Kung-vong），系航空委员会成员。

在该分会的主持下，自1934年12月18日起，连续四个星期的星期二下午4时30分至5时，通过福州路的大中华药房广播电台播发了关于防空的讲座。曾试图获取这些讲座的文稿，但未成功。除上述宣传外，上海分会迄今未开展其他活动，也未出版任何小册子。

上海市防空学会，前身为上海市防空研究会，是在上海市政府指导下成立的组织，其办公地点位于杜美路175号。该学会是月刊《上海防空》的出版方。

截至目前，该期刊已出版五期，其中第4期和第5期合订为一卷，于1935年8月15日发行。这些杂志的内容主要涉及航空和防空，并刊登有关这些主题的照片，但也包含对当前政治事件的评论。

April 28, 1935. Morning translation.

MEETING OF THE SHANGHAI AIR DEFENCE ASSOCIATION

The Shanghai Air Defence Association held a
meeting on April 25 at the Shanghai City Government.
Representatives from the local Tangpu, the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner' s Headquarters, the Bureau of
Education and other Chinese official organs were present.
Mayor Wu Te-chen was in the chair.

The following resolutions were discussed and
passed:-

1. That a Special Committee of the Association be
inaugurated on May 1.

2. That a Shanghai Citizens' Air Defence & Protection
Corps be formed.

3. That the Peace Preservation Corps, the Chinese Boy
Scouts Committee and the Bureau of Education draw up
measures for anti-air raid drill.

Translation of an article from a monthly magazine entitled
the Shanghai Air Defence(上海防空), Vol. I, Issue No.1,
dated April, 1935.

CHINESE PEOPLE SHOULD HAVE SOME UNDERSTANDING
OF CONDITIONS IN PAN HUNG.

Recently reports have been current of a dispute
in Pan Hung(班洪) and an attack on Yunnan by British forces.
The Executive Yuan has sent a wire to Yunnan asking for
particulars but has, so far, received no reply. The problem
of Pan Hung is undoubtedly one which affects China's national
defence.

Britain's object in invading Pan Hung is to
give effect to her "Three C Policy". She must first possess
Pan Hung in order to secure access to the Yangtse Valley so
that she will be in a position to control both India and the
Yangtse Valley. This ambition has already been disclosed
to the public in a book entitled "Communication between
Yunnan, India and the Yangtse Valley," written by a British
named Davis who had explored Yunnan.

After annexing Burma, Britain has been anxious
to enter the province of Szechuen through Yunnan so that she
might have the north and south of the Yangtse River under her
influence. In the 20th year of Kwang Hsu(光緒), the
British secretly removed the boundary stone and occupied
Ko Yui Prefecture(科于市) where they established postal,
telegraph, educational and missionary organs; they also
favoured the immigration by the five tribes under the king
of Hu Lu(葫蘆). Subsequent to the Manchurian Incident on
September 18, 1931, the British extended their activities to
Pan Hung. In December, 1933 eight British subjects were
discovered holding secret meetings and despatching large
numbers of labourers to open mines there. A dispute took
place through protests raised by the tribal chieftains.
pages.zh:
摘自1935年4月出版的《上海防空》（上海防空）月刊第一卷第一期的文章译文。

中国人民应当了解班洪的情况。

近期有关于班洪（Pan Hung）发生争端以及英军进攻云南的报道流传。行政院已致电云南询问详情，但迄今未获回复。班洪问题无疑关系到中国的国防。

英国入侵班洪的目的是为了实施其“三C政策”。她必须先占有班洪，以确保进入长江流域的通道，从而能够控制印度和长江流域。这一野心已在一名曾勘探过云南的英国人戴维斯（Davis）所著的《云南、印度与长江流域之交通》一书中向公众披露。

英国在吞并缅甸后，一直急于通过云南进入四川省，以便使其势力涵盖长江南北。光绪二十年，英国人秘密移走界碑，占领了科于市（Ko Yui Prefecture），并在那里设立了邮政、电报、教育和传教机构；他们还优待葫蘆王（King of Hu Lu）统领下的五个部落移民。继1931年9月18日满洲事变之后，英国将其活动扩展至班洪。1933年12月，发现八名英国人在那里举行秘密会议并派遣大量劳工开矿。因部落首领提出抗议，发生了争端。

pages.en:
- 2 -

Pan Hung is a mountainous district situated to
the south-west of Yunnan. It is about 900 miles in width
from east to west and about 2,000 miles in length from south
to north. It has a population of 200,000, 20% of whom are
Mohammedans and Chinese, the remainder being natives of
various tribes. It is rich in minerals, especially silver.
Coal and gold mines are also abundant.

In former times the Chinese people were ignorant
of the conditions in border districts; they regarded Hongkong
as an "isolated island" when annexed by Britain and Shanghai
as a "fishing village" when ceded as settlements. Look at
Hongkong and Shanghai to-day! We hope that the Chinese
people will not regard Pan Hung as an isolated island or a
fishing village again. We should realize that Pan Hung
stands in the way of Britain's "Three C Policy," and the
importance of its geographical location will in future prove
to be far ■■■■ greater than that of Shanghai and Hongkong.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

班洪是位于云南西南部的山区。东西宽约900英里，南北长约2,000英里。人口20万，其中20%为穆斯林和汉族，其余为各部落土著。矿产资源丰富，尤其是银矿。煤矿和金矿也很丰富。

过去，中国人民对边境地区的情况一无所知；当香港被英国吞并时，他们视其为“孤岛”；当上海被划为租界时，他们视其为“渔村”。看看今天的香港和上海！我们希望中国人民不再将班洪视为孤岛或渔村。我们应该认识到，班洪阻碍了英国的“三C政策”，其地理位置的重要性在未来将被证明远 ■■■■ 大于上海和香港。

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by (签名)

One galvanized-iron sheet (measuring 1 foot by
6 feet) and four boards (measuring 8 feet by 12 feet) bearing
propaganda in favour of air defence have been erected in the
Public Recreation Ground, 200 Dah Chih Road, Nantao, by the
China Aviation Society. The tablet is inscribed "Air
Defence for National Salvation", while the boards bear
drawings and inscriptions in Chinese as follows :-
1st board "A country without air defence has no national
defence. Without national defence a country cannot
exist. The only protection of a country and people from
attacks by enemy aeroplanes is air defence."
2nd board "During an air attack at the present time,
there is no difference between soldiers and civilians,
and the only means to safeguard ones' life and property
is to exert every effort to establish air defence."
3rd board A map of China, entitled "China under air attacks
by the Powers", with five aeroplanes displayed as be-
longing to Japan, Russia, Great Britain, France and U.S.A.
4th board A drawing entitled "Air attack and air defence",
depicting men being killed and wounded and houses burned
during an aerial bombardment.

January 19, 1937.
6681.

-4-

Chinese Chamber of Commerce appeals for a reduction
in licence fees of pawnshops

At the request of local pawnshop owners, the Chinese
Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow Road, submitted a
petition on January 18 to the Ministry of Finance
requesting a reduction in licence fees of pawnshops.

Anti-Air Raid and Poison Gas Exhibition - to be opened
in Western District

An anti-air raid and poison gas exhibition, sponsored
by the Western District Social Centre, and the Anti-Air
Raid Society, will be opened on the premises of the
Social Centre, 420C Robison Road, on January 20. The
exhibition, which will consist of model aeroplanes, pictures
and photographs, will be held for a period of ten days.

Copies of a handbill advertising the exhibition
have been distributed to shops and residences in the
Western Area.

Naval

Movements of Naval Vessels

The gunboat "Yung-chien" arrived at Kachongmiao from
Kiangyin at 8 a.m. January 18.

6681。

-4-

中华总商会呼吁降低当铺执照费

应本地当铺业主请求，位于苏州路北路的中华总商会于1月18日向财政部提交请愿书，要求降低当铺执照费。

防毒气及防空展览 - 将在西区开幕

由西区社会中心及防空协会赞助的防毒气及防空展览，将于1月20日在罗别根路420C号社会中心场地开幕。该展览将展出飞机模型、图画和照片，为期十天。

宣传该展览的传单副本已分发给西区的商店和住户。

海军

舰艇动态

“永健”号炮舰于1月18日上午8时从江阴抵达茄宗庙。

August 24, 1936.

Citizens' Protection Group - preparatory office established
The reparatory office of a new organization entitled
"Citizens' Protection Group" (市民防護團) formed for
the purpose of instructing citizens in taking anti-gas
precautions was established on August 23 at 200 Dah Chih
Road, Nantao. The principal promoter is Li Dah Chao
(李大超), Chief of the 1st Department of the Shanghai
City Government.
